title: +414% since previous close · ROP $430 Call · $3.50 → $18.00
text:
+414% since previous close · ROP $430 Call · $3.50 → $18.00

Previous-session daily close → session aggregate close.

• For the $430 call’s 1:24 PM ET option aggregate on October 22, ROP’s corresponding minute-bar open was approximately $433.58, up 9.06% from the $397.56 previous close; this is an approximate time match.

• The earnings thread reports Q3 revenue of $2.172B, up 8%, with 7% organic growth; adjusted EPS rose 15% to $5.89.

• The same thread reports full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to $22.35–$22.40. These results provide context for the stock move.

• The Nov 20 $420 call moved from an Oct 21 daily close of $6.00 to an Oct 22 aggregate close of $25.80: +330%, or +$1,980 for a standard 100-share contract before costs.

• The Nov 20 $430 call moved from $3.50 to $18.00 on the same date basis: +414.29%, or +$1,450 per standard contract before costs.

• The $420 call’s later 3:42 PM ET aggregate uses a separate stock-minute reference of approximately $436.89, up 9.89%; neither comparison is a verified overnight opening-gap return.

• Previous-session volume was 7 contracts for the $420 call and 1 for the $430 call. Current aggregate volumes were 113 and 27; returned open interest was 93 and 30.

• The linked earnings research provides context, not proof of a trade at the starting premium; these are historical option-price comparisons and exclude transaction costs.

If ROP fell 100% to $0 and this bought call became worthless, your maximum premium loss would be $3.50 per share ($350.00 for one 100-share contract). In this case, ROP moved +9.06% since the previous close using an approximate minute-bar reference near the option snapshot, and the call went from $3.50 to $18.00 per share: $1,800.00 ending value and $1,450.00 gain for one contract, before costs.

title: +380% since previous close · ACN $245 Call · $2.28 → $10.94

• The verified near-expiry contract is the ACN $245 call expiring October 23, 2026—one day after the measured session.

• The call moved from a $2.28 October 21 daily close to a $10.94 October 22 session aggregate close: +379.82%. Its aggregate timestamp is October 22 at 3:47 PM ET.

• One standard 100-share contract increased from $228 to $1,094 in value, an $866 gain before transaction costs.

• If ACN fell 100% to $0 and the bought, unexercised call became worthless, the maximum premium loss would be $2.28 per share or $228 for one contract, plus costs.
